messages:
Jane (product): Heads up — Customer X asked for the ability to fully manage perimeter rules for their private deployment. They want both: pushable firewall rules from on-prem and route-level control for BGP handoffs. Need an RFC + launch checklist by EOW. Key asks: customer-managed rules, clear precedence, audit logs, safe cert rotation. Thoughts?

Arjun (eng): Do we expect an agent to be required, or allow config via our control plane (customer pushes manifest to our API)?

Olga (security): Security requirement: any inbound rules that open control-plane ports (22, 443, our admin ports) must be rejected or require a secondary approval flag. We also need schema validation and signed manifests.

Luis (networking): From networking POV, BGP route handoffs are more scalable for routing, but many customers want explicit firewall rule control. We can support both: route-based handoff for path-level decisions + a small fw-sync agent for packet-filter rules. Need clear precedence rules.

Maya (solutions): Customer expects to manage rules from their existing firewall UI. We should provide a lightweight sync daemon (fw-sync) and a push API for customers that want to programmatically upload rule sets. Also need a test harness for them to validate before pushing prod rules.

Jane (product): Draft acceptance criteria (rough):
1) Customer can apply a validated rule set either via fw-sync agent or by uploading a signed manifest to the control plane API.
2) Control plane enforces a denylist for critical ports and refuses unsafe rules; rejection reason surfaced in Console and audit logs.
3) All customer rule changes are versioned and visible in Console audit trail.
4) Certs/keys used by fw-sync support zero-downtime rotation (grace period 48h).
5) Nightly regression tests covering conflict resolution, connectivity recovery, and large rule sets.
6) Rollout plan: canary to 3 customers, then open beta.

Arjun (eng): Edge cases to call out in RFC: split-brain where both agent and BGP inject conflicting routes/rules (proposal: precedence agent > customer-BGP > default), transient connectivity between agent and control plane (must queue changes with TTL), and large rule set performance (apply in batches).

Olga (security): Add to acceptance: signed manifests (OIDC or client cert), validation rules that forbid 0.0.0.0/0 for control-plane-facing rules, rate-limit rule changes, and an emergency kill-switch to revoke customer rules instantly.

Luis (networking): Ops runbook items: how to revoke customer configs, how to fallback to our default route map, health checks (BGP RIB sync status), and monitoring alerts for policy drift. Also note: NAT vs no-NAT customer topologies need separate docs.

Jane (product): Prioritization note: Customer X is willing to pay for Dedicated + Private. Estimate 3 sprints for an MVP (fw-sync agent + manifest API + basic Console UI). Phase 2: BGP route policy translation and advanced rule templating. Recommend shipping MVP first; defer full BGP policy IR translation.

Maya (solutions): I'll draft a test matrix: functional (rule apply/rollback), security (reject unsafe rules), perf (time-to-apply for 5k rules), resilience (agent churn, network partition), and UX (error messages in Console). Will attach sample test vectors.

Arjun (eng): Example manifest prototype:
```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "author": "customer-x",
  "rules": [
    {"id": "allow-api", "src": "10.0.0.0/24", "dst": "10.1.0.12/32", "port": "443", "action": "allow", "ttl": 86400}
  ]
}
```
We should include TTL and revocation tokens so we can expire problematic rules automatically.

Jane (product): Proposed owners for RFC and launch: Arjun (eng lead), Olga (security), Luis (networking), Maya (solutions). Can each of you ack? Also who can drive the rollout plan and beta customers?

Arjun (eng): Ack. I'll draft the RFC skeleton and include the precedence rules.

Olga (security): Ack. I'll add the validation rules and emergency rollback flow.

Luis (networking): Ack. I'll draft the ops runbook and BGP considerations.

Maya (solutions): Ack — I'll coordinate beta customers and test matrix.

deploy-bot: RFC template created: https://redwood.example.com/rfcs/priv-fw-routing-2021 (created by Jane) :white_check_mark:

Jane (product): Thanks — I'll collate these into a PRD and ping for review once the RFC draft is up. If we can get an RFC ready by Wed EOD we can scope the first sprint next week. :calendar:
